events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the 35th anniversary of the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost him, but Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: A Game Changer
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' and changed everything. Which track from this iconic album still hits different for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic passing of The Beatles' iconic songwriter, John Lennon.

angles.name: Imagine the Legacy
angles.copy: His message of peace and love endures. Today, we remember John Lennon, a true visionary whose music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary chameleon of rock, David Bowie, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Forever pushing boundaries. David Bowie would have turned 80 today, a true icon whose influence is still felt across music and culture. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: 92 years since his birth, Elvis Presley's legacy as the King of Rock and Roll continues to electrify. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist and producer, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs continue to define rock music. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter, Sir Rod Stewart, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Maggie May's Main Man
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart. What's your favourite of his timeless hits?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: One Step Beyond 66
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the inimitable Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing ska and good times for decades. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat...
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! His voice defined an era. What's your favourite Paul Young hit?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Jolene's Creator at 81
angles.copy: From humble beginnings to global superstar, Dolly Parton turns 81 today! An incredible songwriter, performer, and philanthropist. Which of her songs is your favourite?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: A Million Love Songs Later
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, he's given us countless hits. What's your favourite Gary Barlow moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British soul and R&B singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen Turns 77
angles.copy: Get ready to feel some 'Love Really Hurts Without You' vibes! Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean. What's your favourite of his feel-good tracks?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held, honouring rock's founding legends.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame welcomed its first class of legends. Who do you think was the most deserving of that initial honour?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Mark at 55
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the ever-charming Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's still got it. What's your favourite Mark Owen track?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: The Last Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. Imagine being there! What's your favourite moment from that iconic performance?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed drummer and solo artist, Phil Collins, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight, He's 76
angles.copy: From Genesis to solo superstardom, Phil Collins has given us some unforgettable tunes. Happy 76th birthday! What's the Phil Collins song that always gets you?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Oh, Hugh!
angles.copy: From charming rom-com lead to versatile character actor, Hugh Grant turns 67 today! Which of his iconic roles is your favourite?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former NSYNC member, Justin Timberlake, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's 46th
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back for his 46th birthday! Wishing Justin Timberlake a fantastic day. What's your favourite JT banger?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, best known as Del Boy, Sir David Jason, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly 87th!
angles.copy: He's given us so many unforgettable characters. Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago, we lost three incredible talents. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer, Rick Astley, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up on 61
angles.copy: He's still got that voice! Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley. What's your favourite Rickroll moment, or simply your favourite of his songs?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae musician and global icon, Bob Marley, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: His music and message continue to resonate worldwide. Bob Marley would have been 82 today. What's your favourite Bob Marley song?

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The prolific singer-songwriter and 'Tapestry' artist, Carole King, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: You've Got a Friend at 85
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Her songs have soundtracked generations. What's your favourite track penned by this songwriting legend?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of the incomparable vocal powerhouse, Whitney Houston.

angles.name: The Voice Lives On
angles.copy: Her voice was truly one of a kind. Today, we remember the legendary Whitney Houston and her incredible musical legacy. What's your favourite Whitney song?

events.title: Take That's Original Split Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the day in 1996 when Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts across the UK.

angles.name: The Day The Tears Flowed
angles.copy: 29 years ago, the news broke: Take That were splitting up! We all remember where we were. What was your reaction to the original split?

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine & 68
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the unmistakable voice of UB40! What's your favourite track from the reggae legends?

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Thinking Out Loud at 36
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the incredible Ed Sheeran! From busking to stadium tours, he's a true musical phenomenon. What's your favourite Ed Sheeran song?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The Beatles' lead guitarist and esteemed songwriter, George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Here Comes The Sun, He'd Be 84
angles.copy: Remembering the quiet Beatle, George Harrison, who would have turned 84 today. His songwriting brought so much depth to the band and beyond. What's your favourite Harrison composition?
